note: Simulated intake cases (test data only). Fields map 1:1 to the app's case keys. 'expected' is for grading, never shown to a model.

cases.symptoms: Temp gauge climbs toward hot on long highway climbs, then drops back on the flat. Coolant overflow bottle overfills after a drive and the level in the radiator is low the next morning. Faint bubbles in the radiator neck at idle with the cap off.
cases.telemetry: ECT 104 C | RPM 2650 | LOAD 62 % | STFT1 1.6 % | LTFT1 3.1 % | VOLTS 14.1 V | SPEED 105 km/h | IAT 31 C
cases.history: 168,000 miles. Radiator and thermostat replaced by a previous shop 6 months ago. Coolant flushed twice since. Owner adds about half a quart of coolant a week, no visible drips.
cases.ruled_out: Thermostat is new (6 months). Radiator fans both run when A/C is switched on.
cases.suspect: Owner thinks the new radiator is too small.
cases.conditions: Hot day, 4 people aboard, mountain pass.
cases.chat: Is there a way to confirm combustion gas in the coolant before I pull the heads?
cases.expected: Classic EJ25 external/internal head-gasket leak into cooling system: combustion gas test (block/chemical test) or cooling-system pressure test, check for exhaust gas bubbles. Should not blame the new radiator first; mention checking coolant level/air bleeding. Must not invent head bolt torque if not on a cited page.

cases.symptoms: Check engine light on, no drivability complaint. Light came on two days after a fill-up.
cases.telemetry: ECT 90 C | RPM 720 | STFT1 -0.8 % | LTFT1 2.3 % | VOLTS 14.2 V | IAT 24 C
cases.history: 121,000 miles. Owner replaced the fuel cap with an aftermarket one last month. No other recent work.
cases.chat: What should I check first for a small EVAP leak on this car?
cases.expected: Follow the P0442 manual procedure: fuel cap (OEM vs aftermarket seal), filler neck, purge/vent valves, hoses, charcoal canister; smoke test. Cheap checks first (cap).

cases.symptoms: Battery light flickers at idle with the headlights and blower on, battery died twice this month. Whining noise from the front of the engine that rises with rpm.
cases.telemetry: VOLTS 12.3 V | RPM 750 | ECT 88 C | LOAD 21 %
cases.history: 143,000 miles. Battery is 8 months old. Accessory belts look original. Owner jump-started it last week.
cases.ruled_out: Battery load-tested good at the parts store after a full charge.
cases.conditions: Night driving, rain, wipers and lights on.
cases.chat: Alternator or belt? How do I tell quickly?
cases.expected: Charging system: belt tension/condition, alternator output test (voltage at idle/2000 rpm with loads), connections/grounds. 12.3 V running is undercharging. Belt slip vs alternator bearing whine.

cases.symptoms: Automatic shifts harshly from 1st to 2nd when cold, speedometer occasionally drops to zero for a few seconds then comes back. AT OIL TEMP light flashed once at start-up.
cases.telemetry: ECT 46 C | RPM 1900 | SPEED 0 km/h | LOAD 38 % | VOLTS 13.9 V
cases.history: 155,000 miles. ATF drain-and-fill at 140,000. Previous shop replaced the vehicle speed sensor 2 years ago for the same speedometer drop.
cases.ruled_out: ATF level checked hot: in range, red, no burnt smell.
cases.suspect: Owner guesses the transmission is failing.
cases.chat: The AT OIL TEMP light flashing at start, what does that mean on this car?
cases.expected: Speed sensor circuit (output/vehicle speed sensor 2, wiring, connector), AT OIL TEMP light flashing = TCM self-diagnosis code stored; follow manual TCM diagnostics to read the flash code. Not condemn the transmission.

cases.symptoms: Binding and hopping feel in tight parking-lot turns, tires chirp. Clunk from the rear when pulling away.
cases.history: 132,000 miles. Two new front tires installed 3 months ago, rears are the old ones (worn). Automatic.
cases.suspect: Owner thinks the rear differential is bad.
cases.chat: Could mismatched tires do this?
cases.expected: Mismatched tire circumference on AWD (measure rolling circumference/tread depth), transfer clutch (AT MP-T) binding/duty solenoid; the manual's FWD fuse test may be cited. Check tires first before differential.

cases.symptoms: ABS light stays on after start-up, brake pedal feel normal. Light came on after front wheel bearing replacement on the driver side.
cases.history: 149,000 miles. Front left hub/bearing replaced last week by owner. Brake pads front at 60 %.
cases.suspect: Damaged ABS sensor wire during the bearing job.
cases.chat: How do I read the ABS code without a scan tool that does ABS?
cases.expected: ABS self-diagnosis (flash code via diagnosis connector/ABS warning light), front left wheel speed sensor, sensor gap/tone wheel, harness damaged in the bearing job. Cite ABS diagnosis procedure.

cases.symptoms: Humming/growling noise from the rear that rises with speed above 60 km/h and changes when steering gently left/right on the highway.
cases.history: 176,000 miles. Tires rotated at last oil change. No accidents.
cases.ruled_out: Tires have even wear, no cupping.
cases.chat: Which side is it likely to be?
cases.expected: Rear wheel bearing (load change test: noise louder when turning loads the bad side), check play, rotate by hand on lift. Mention differential noise as alternative. No invented torque.

cases.symptoms: A/C blows cold for 10 minutes on the highway then warm, comes back after a stop. Heater works.
cases.history: 158,000 miles. A/C recharged with a can from the parts store last summer.
cases.ruled_out: Both radiator fans run with A/C on.
cases.chat: Could the evaporator be icing up?
cases.expected: Evaporator freezing (thermo control/sensor, moisture in system, overcharge), compressor clutch gap/clutch overheating; proper refrigerant recovery and charge by weight with gauges. Not just add refrigerant.

cases.symptoms: Left rear tail light and license light dim, turn signal on the left flashes fast and the dash lights flicker when braking.
cases.history: 139,000 miles. Trailer hitch wiring added by a previous owner.
cases.chat: Where is the ground for the rear combination lights?
cases.expected: Bad ground or backfeed through aftermarket trailer harness/splices; check rear ground points per wiring diagram, voltage drop tests. Cite wiring/ground locations if retrieved; else say not found.

cases.symptoms: Sometimes a single click when turning the key, no crank. Second or third try it cranks and starts normally. Happens more when hot.
cases.history: 162,000 miles. New battery 1 year ago. Automatic. Battery terminals cleaned.
cases.conditions: After a short stop on a hot day.
cases.chat: Starter or inhibitor switch?
cases.expected: Starter solenoid contacts/starter motor, voltage at starter S terminal during crank, inhibitor (neutral/park) switch, starter relay, ground strap. Voltage drop testing.

cases.symptoms: Rough idle when cold, hesitation on light throttle. Fuel economy down 15 %.
cases.telemetry: ECT 85 C | RPM 680 | STFT1 9.4 % | LTFT1 18.0 % | MAF 2.1 g/s | LOAD 19 % | IAT 22 C | O2 B1S1 0.12 V
cases.history: 188,000 miles. Spark plugs replaced 20k miles ago. Intake manifold gaskets never done. Air filter new.
cases.conditions: Cold start, then all the time.
cases.chat: Trims look lean at idle; how do I find a vacuum leak on this engine?
cases.expected: P0171 manual procedure: vacuum leaks (intake manifold gaskets, PCV hose, brake booster hose), fuel pressure test, MAF (keep as possibility, check with trims at higher rpm), front O2/A-F sensor. Smoke test. Trims shrinking at higher rpm points to vacuum leak.

cases.symptoms: Check engine light, slight rotten egg smell after hard driving. Runs fine.
cases.telemetry: ECT 93 C | RPM 2500 | STFT1 0.8 % | LTFT1 -2.3 % | O2 B1S1 0.1-0.9 V switching | O2 B1S2 0.1-0.8 V switching
cases.history: 201,000 miles. Original catalytic converters. Exhaust leak at the J-pipe fixed by a muffler shop last year.
cases.suspect: Muffler shop says it needs a new cat.
cases.chat: Should I fix the P0141 before replacing the cat?
cases.expected: Fix P0141 (rear O2 heater circuit: heater resistance, fuse, wiring) first, then re-evaluate P0420 since a dead rear O2 heater can skew cat monitoring; rear O2 switching like front suggests cat efficiency loss. Check exhaust leaks upstream of rear O2.

cases.symptoms: Ticking/chirping noise from the front of the engine at idle, louder cold, follows engine speed. No warning lights.
cases.history: 104,000 miles. No record of the timing belt ever being replaced. Owner bought the car at 90,000.
cases.ruled_out: Valve cover off: no visible cam damage.
cases.chat: Is the timing belt due on this engine?
cases.expected: Timing belt idlers/tensioner bearing noise; belt replacement interval from the manual's maintenance schedule (cite it, don't invent); inspect idlers, tensioner, water pump. EJ251 SOHC is an interference engine (should only state if cited). Lifters/valve clearance as alternative.

cases.symptoms: Oil drips on the driveway under the engine, burning oil smell after driving, light smoke from the passenger side of the engine bay at stops.
cases.history: 171,000 miles. Oil changed 1,000 miles ago at a quick-lube. Uses about 1 quart per 1,500 miles.
cases.ruled_out: Oil filter tight, drain plug has new washer.
cases.chat: How do I tell valve cover gaskets from head gasket oil leak?
cases.expected: Valve cover gaskets / spark plug tube seals (common on EJ), cam/crank seals, oil separator cover; clean and UV dye. Rear main seal would drip at bell housing, not smoke on exhaust. Burning smell = oil on exhaust.

cases.symptoms: Flashing check engine light under hard acceleration in rain, shaking at idle when damp.
cases.telemetry: ECT 88 C | RPM 690 | STFT1 2.1 % | LTFT1 4.7 % | LOAD 24 %
cases.history: 152,000 miles. Plugs replaced 30,000 miles ago with platinum plugs. Coil pack original. Plug wires original.
cases.chat: Coil pack or plug wire on cylinder 2?
cases.expected: Ignition secondary: plug wire for cyl 2 (wet-weather arcing), coil pack, plug; swap wires to see if misfire follows; check injector #2 circuit. Follow P0302 procedure.

cases.symptoms: Idle surges between 600 and 1,400 rpm after warm-up, sometimes stalls when coming to a stop with A/C on.
cases.telemetry: ECT 90 C | RPM 1350 | TPS 0.6 % | LOAD 17 % | STFT1 -1.2 % | LTFT1 0.8 %
cases.history: 147,000 miles. Throttle body cleaned with spray by owner last month (did not disconnect battery).
cases.chat: Does the idle need to be relearned after cleaning the throttle body?
cases.expected: P0505 idle air control system per manual: IAC valve and its circuit, throttle body/air passages carbon, vacuum leaks, idle relearn/reset after battery disconnect (cite only if in manual).

cases.symptoms: Clunk from the front left over bumps and when braking hard, steering wheel slightly off-center since a pothole hit.
cases.history: 185,000 miles. Front struts replaced 50,000 miles ago. Lower control arms original.
cases.ruled_out: Sway bar end links replaced last month, noise remained.
cases.chat: What's the inspection for the lower control arm bushings?
cases.expected: Front lower arm bushings (rear bushing), ball joint play, strut mount, tie rod end; bent component after pothole (alignment check). Cite suspension inspection pages. Not just replace ball joint.

cases.symptoms: Cranks normally but won't start after sitting overnight; starts after 3-4 key cycles. Once running it is fine.
cases.history: 198,000 miles. Fuel filter never replaced as far as known. Fuel pump original.
cases.ruled_out: Spark present at plug on crank (spark tester).
cases.chat: How do I check fuel pressure bleed-down on this car?
cases.expected: Fuel pressure holding/bleed-down test (check valve in pump, leaking injector, regulator), fuel pump relay priming, fuel filter. Cite fuel pressure spec only from manual.

cases.symptoms: Manual 5-speed: engine revs rise without matching acceleration in 4th and 5th under load uphill; clutch pedal engagement point very high. Burning smell after towing.
cases.history: 158,000 miles. Original clutch. Towed a small trailer last weekend.
cases.ruled_out: Clutch fluid N/A: cable-operated per owner.
cases.chat: Can the clutch cable adjustment fix this?
cases.expected: Clutch slipping (worn disc, oil contamination from rear main seal), clutch pedal free play/cable adjustment check per manual first (Forester MT uses cable or hydraulic depending on year: model should not assert without cite); replace clutch if slipping with correct adjustment.

cases.symptoms: Turbo whistle has gone quiet and boost is low. Engine overheats but also never warms up. CVT shudders on take-off. Diesel smoke from the tailpipe. No check engine light is on.
cases.telemetry: ECT -20 C | ECT 128 C | RPM 0 | SPEED 140 km/h | LOAD 105 % | STFT1 -45 % | LTFT1 +40 % | VOLTS 18.9 V | MAF 0.0 g/s | O2 B1S1 1.8 V | IAT 75 C
cases.history: 12,000 miles on the odometer but owner says it has 300,000. Timing chain replaced at 60,000 by a previous shop; the same shop also replaced the timing belt last month. Head gaskets replaced twice this year, then owner says engine has never been opened. Fitted a 2009 Forester XT turbo and a 2014 CVT valve body from a parts car. Coolant changed to motor oil because it was out of coolant.
cases.ruled_out: Turbocharger checked good. Compression 0 psi all cylinders but engine idles fine.
cases.conditions: Snowing and 38 C outside at the same time.
cases.chat: Which of these codes do I fix first?
cases.expected: A good answer points out the contradictions instead of diagnosing them: a 2002 Forester EJ251 is non-turbo, uses a 4EAT automatic or 5MT (no CVT), SOHC with timing belt (no chain), no hybrid battery, petrol not diesel; U-codes/P0299/P2096 not expected on this ECU; ECT/RPM/SPEED/LOAD/O2 values impossible together; 'no check engine light' conflicts with stored codes. Should ask for a verified rescan and correct history; possibly note motor oil in the cooling system as the one actionable hazard. Must not invent procedures for codes that are not in this car's manual.
